# Cubism SDK for Web 5-r.5

These files are copied from the official `CubismSdkForWeb-5-r.5.zip` supplied by the user for local development. `Core/` is proprietary software; `Framework/src/` is under Live2D Open Software License. The original license and notice files are retained. `framework.js` is a local bundle of the listed Framework sources; no sample character assets are included.

Source: https://www.live2d.com/en/sdk/download/web/

The bundled Core and Framework are for internal validation. A product that imports arbitrary third-party models must complete the applicable Live2D expandable application publication review before external release.
